name: backlit
title: 背光、透光
what: Light through the object: a small softbox straight behind it, hidden by it (transmitted light: thin porcelain, jade, paper, horn, a leaf glow), two small softboxes high behind for rims along the arc, a weak front fill, and a light on the ground behind (a coloured ground, a sky).

look_target.note: a reference film: a look target for the light only, never material truth

shots.what: lychee flesh: lit through from behind, rim of light on the skin, dark ground
leaf: light from behind, the edge and the dew drop glowing on a dark ground
red lantern: light through the paper against a bright sky

spectrum.why: v0: every lamp of a rig has the same spectrum, the key light rgbscene projects with, so one bounce is exact (docs/optics.md); 5500 K blackbody: a stand-in for daylight-balanced studio flash or LED, our choice

lamps.name: through
lamps.why: our choice: a small round softbox close behind the part of the object in the frame, facing it, hidden by it (checked: its outline stays under the object's upper silhouette); small and close, so the glow falls off from its middle (S3: a wide one lit the plate evenly, flat)

lamps.name: rim_left
lamps.why: high behind, left: a rim along the arc

lamps.name: ground
lamps.why: washes the ground behind from above, out of frame: a coloured ground or a sky

backdrop.why: the default ground; a recipe sets the colour for its object (backdrop.material)
